faq.title: Join a community of language learners

slashCommand.question: What's the // command?
slashCommand.answer: Type // anywhere in your journal and write in your own words — Folio translates it inline, right where you're writing. No tab-switching, no breaking your flow.

privacy.question: Is my journal private?
privacy.answer: Absolutely. Your entries are yours alone. We don't share your writing with anyone, and nothing is used to train AI models.

report.question: How do I report a problem on Folio?
report.answer: We're here to help! Tap <feedbackLink>click here</feedbackLink> or the Feedback button anytime — whether you've hit a bug, have a feature idea, or just need a hand.

beta.question: What's a beta version?
beta.answer: Folio is in early access, which means we're still actively building and improving things. It's completely free right now, and you might run into the occasional bug — if you do, tell us and we'll get on it.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes, no strings attached. You can cancel your subscription whenever you like, or delete your account entirely from Settings.

startLevel.question: Do I need to know the language to start?
startLevel.answer: Not at all — you're welcome to start from scratch. That said, Folio is best if you already know a few basics and want to practice putting sentences together.
